display_name: Source-bound tree-sitter AST summary (functions, call sites, imports)
validation_rules: run treesitter_ast.py from the vendored /opt/treesitter venv of a pinned compiler image in the offline B13 boundary
the script is a content-addressed copy mounted read-only; no repo script is copied into the image and no target code is executed
large outputs are a hash-bound records file; the summary carries the document content_sha256
oversized, unreadable, symlinked and grammar-less files are gaps, never silent omissions
rows are locators that require source dereference before citation
